newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mail-Well estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mail-Well estimates raised.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Friday it raised its earnings estimate for Mail-Well Inc for 1997 to $2.00 a share from $1.85 and the estimate for 1998 to $2.32 from $2.15.

-- Hanifen said the company posted strong first-quarter results of $0.50 a share versus $0.23 last year. The latest figure reflects profitability in Mail-Well's envelope and printing operations well above Hanifen's industry forecast, Hanifen said.
-- Mail-Well is positioned to continue to exceed Wall Street expectations in subsequent quarters in 1997 and 1998, Hanifen said.
-- The company is also actively seeking acquisitions and is likely yo complete one or more acquisitions over the next 12 to 18 months, Hanifen said.
-- Mail-Well makes envelopes and commercial printing services.
-- Its shares were up 3/4 Friday at 27.
